mappings.product_miss: The shared public economy path could recognise money pressure around basic needs but did not distinguish accumulated debt/inkasso from immediate inability to cover rent, electricity, food or medicine. This could hide municipal budget/debt counselling or over-generalise a debt story into economic assistance.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the existing economic_assistance focus and add only the coarse context=debt. Route clear accumulated-debt stories to current municipal budget/debt counselling; preserve the existing acute housing/basic-needs route when immediate essential-cost risk is explicit. Do not create a debt app, a debt target-group engine or an eligibility calculator.
mappings.truth_guardrail: Konsumentverket can support the existence and scope of municipal budget/debt counselling, Kronofogden can support debt-enforcement and debt-restructuring information, and Socialstyrelsen can support economic-assistance information. None of those sources or routes proves the individual's eligibility, creditor outcome, debt cancellation, amount or deadline.
mappings.privacy_guardrail: The public handoff may contain only actor_type=private_person, focus=economic_assistance, context=debt|housing|basic_needs|general and language. Never place creditor names, exact debt amount, account information, address, identity, raw story or sensitive household details in the URL or structured feedback.
